title: res.status()
definition: Sets the HTTP status for the response. It is a chainable alias of Node's `response.statusCode`. Standard REST practices require sending appropriate status codes (200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found, 500 Server Error).
simpleExplanation: Sets the HTTP status for the response.
